about: Whether a file name is the one a note of this title gets, letter case aside (then the tree shows the title alone): its base (without a note extension) equals the title, or the title's safe-base, or, for a base of at least 20 UTF-16 units shorter than the title's safe-base, the title's safe-base cut to the base's length. input: { title, file } → expected boolean.
